# Vendor Dependencies

BigBaseV2 uses a mix of Git submodules and build-bootstrapped dependencies.
Run the following command before generating the Visual Studio solution:

```powershell
.\scripts\update-vendors.ps1
```

The normal build script runs this automatically:

```powershell
.\scripts\build-enhanced.ps1
```

## Pinned versions

| Dependency | Location | Source type | Pinned version |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dear ImGui | `vendor/ImGui` | Git submodule | `v1.92.8` |
| fmt | `vendor/fmtlib` | Git submodule | `12.1.0` |
| nlohmann/json | `vendor/json` | Git submodule | `v3.12.0` |
| MinHook | `vendor/MinHook` | Git submodule | `v1.3.4` |
| StackWalker | `vendor/StackWalker` | Git submodule | `7af402408202a5c00021fd57e18e39e7e6f11062` |
| Sol2 | `vendor/sol2` | Bootstrapped Git checkout | `v3.3.0` |
| Lua | `vendor/lua` | Bootstrapped official source archive | `5.4.8` |

## Important layout notes

Dear ImGui backends are compiled from `vendor/ImGui/backends`, not the legacy `examples` directory. The build includes `imgui_tables.cpp`.

Sol2 and Lua are generated by `scripts/update-vendors.ps1` because they were referenced by the project but were not declared in `.gitmodules`. Their folders are intentionally ignored by Git.

Do not manually edit third-party files. Apply project-specific compatibility changes in `BigBaseV2/src` or the build scripts instead.
